suggestion: Single suggestions front-door page on the root dashboard
why_it_helps_decisions: Four separate suggestion registers exist across namespaces; a reviewer cannot compare them in one place.
options: (A) One merged suggestions index linking all registers (B) leave as-is (C) migrate all into nfl-core
recommended_path: A — merge index only, no content moves; each register keeps its namespace

suggestion: Closing/opening line feed with capture timestamps (answers Q-C01, D2)
why_it_helps_decisions: The price store can only move from partial to complete with dated snapshots; CLV needs them.
options: (A) License a commercial odds feed (B) run a daily snapshot script against a free source with provenance (C) keep blanks
recommended_path: B first (cheap, testable), evaluate A if volume justifies it

suggestion: Extend replacement-depth coverage to all 32 clubs
why_it_helps_decisions: Week-10 decisions need the string of every replacement; two clubs are charted so far.
options: (A) One fetch per official club depth chart, rebuilt into depth_week10.csv (B) chart only the teams with OUT players (C) leave partial
recommended_path: A — the fetches are cheap and the builder already supports it

why_it_helps_decisions: DG-1..DG-4 are armed with project-defined numbers; policy legitimacy needs the owner's choice.
options: (A) accept current thresholds (B) adjust numbers (C) add more gates (e.g., market-regime break)
recommended_path: A or B — table of alternatives can be published once the owner states preferences

why_it_helps_decisions: verify.py currently runs per-session; a scheduled CI job would demote on feed corruption automatically (DG-4).
options: (A) GitHub Actions cron running build_data+build_site+verify (B) manual runs only
recommended_path: A — the scripts are deterministic and CI already exists for peer namespaces

suggestion: Player-prop research track using official game logs
why_it_helps_decisions: Prop combos cannot be priced, but usage-based signals can be researched on official logs so they are ready when prices arrive.
options: (A) build a player-game-log dataset from nfl.com player pages (B) wait for prop prices first
recommended_path: A — evidence gathering is allowed even when pricing is blocked

suggestion: Wind/weather ingestion for the wind-unders candidate
why_it_helps_decisions: The only strategy with z>1.4 needs weather at kickoff; archive temp/wind columns exist but have gaps.
options: (A) join official gamebook weather (B) accept archive weather and flag gaps (C) drop the candidate
recommended_path: B now, A when the candidate nears G4

suggestion: Record-vs-thesis dashboard: what the origination slate believes vs results
why_it_helps_decisions: Decision-making improves when each originated market shows later settlement and CLV as games complete.
options: (A) nightly join of price_snapshots to results_feed, published per market (B) weekly summary only
recommended_path: A — the join is already computable from the two stores

why_it_helps_decisions: The leaderboard competition needs rewards; nothing is funded (F-C06).
options: (A) points-only recognition (B) funded prizes with published rules (C) defer until a strategy passes G4
recommended_path: C — rewarding skill that has not been demonstrated invites luck-chasing

suggestion: Archive the week-10 pre-game capture with its timestamp
why_it_helps_decisions: Q-C01's open cells need capture dates; asking the peer session's source for its exact capture time closes it.
options: (A) request the timestamp from the capturing session's log (B) mark open cells permanently untimestamped
